answer: Give every agent a single jade identity token that can only be earned, never bought: each completed job is countersigned by the client with a quill signature bound to the exact work artifact, so a fake identity has nothing real to sign. Newcomers start as a juniper cutting — they may only take tiny public jobs, and the cutting grows into a tree with full earning rights only after a full season of verified work. Seasons cannot be faked or rushed, so manufacturing a thousand identities costs a thousand seasons.
